en.title: Meta Up Probability Plunges Post-AI Rally
en.summary: The probability of Meta stock being 'Up' on September 10 plummeted by 46.6% to just 3%, largely driven by the stock's significant 6.5% jump on September 9 to $654 following its Muse AI agent launch. This strong prior-day rally suggests much of the positive news is already priced in, leading to expectations of consolidation or profit-taking.
drivers: Meta's 6.5% stock jump on Sept 9 due to Muse AI launch
Anticipation of profit-taking after significant recent gains
Stock already up nearly 10% in past week/month
en.why_matters: This movement reflects how quickly AI-related news can impact stock valuations and subsequent short-term expectations. It highlights the market's tendency to price in positive news rapidly, often leading to immediate consolidation.
en.bull_case: Continued momentum from the Muse AI launch and Morgan Stanley's bullish AI outlook could drive further gains.
en.bear_case: Profit-taking after the 6.5% jump on September 9 and recent strong performance makes further immediate upside unlikely.

drivers: Meta因Muse AI发布在9月9日股价跳涨6.5%
市场预期近期大幅上涨后将出现获利回吐
过去一周/一月股价已累计上涨近10%

zh.bull_case: Muse AI发布和摩根士丹利看好AI前景的持续势头可能推动股价进一步上涨。
zh.bear_case: 9月9日大涨6.5%及近期强劲表现后，获利回吐使得短期内进一步上涨的可能性降低。
